title: 2. Passive Reconnaissance (OSINT)
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L12: Recon, Scanning & Network Attacks: 2. Passive Reconnaissance (OSINT).

items: No traffic to target = no log entry on victim infrastructure = no detection signal
All data from publicly accessible sources

rows: Registrar, name servers, sometimes contact email
Exposed PDFs, admin panels, error messages
Email format, employees, tech stack from job posts

blocks.text: ``text site:target.com filetype:pdf # exposed documents site:target.com inurl:admin # admin panels site:target.com filetype:env # leaked .env files site:github.com "target.com" password # GitHub credential leaks intitle:"index of" site:target.com # directory listing ``
``bash shodan search 'org:"Target Corp"' shodan search 'port:3389 country:TH' # exposed RDP in Thailand shodan search 'product:"Apache httpd" version:"2.4.46"' ``
Real-world: Cl0p group enumerated all internet-facing MOVEit servers via Shodan/Censys before exploiting CVE-2023-34362, hitting 2,500+ orgs and 90M+ records (CISA AA23-158A).
